verdict: Leads up sharply this week; cost per lead rising as budget scales.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 27 leads from Meta at a cost of $10.39 per lead, with the most recent week delivering a 137.5% surge in leads week-over-week. That said, spend grew faster than leads (228.2% vs 137.5%), so cost per lead rose 38% week-over-week — a signal that the campaign is working but efficiency will need to be watched as daily budget increases. Two of your three Google Business Profile listings are generating far fewer calls than the third despite similar visibility, and we're reviewing those profiles now to close that gap. Next week you can expect continued lead flow with a focus on tightening cost per lead back toward prior levels.
